rows.grounds: second member of compound describing cakraṃ
adjective qualifying cakraṃ, possessing a pericarp

items.question: What are the defining characteristics of the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified as the object of description.
This cakra is characterized as royal or kingly.
This cakra possesses eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is a royal, eight-petaled wheel endowed with a pericarp.
uncertainties: The specific referent of rājānam as a metaphorical epithet is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: The sixth cakra, moreover, is the royal one, having eight petals and a pericarp.
